elements.text:
• 3 sub-cohorts (Ga/Si/Ju) collected under different conditions:
  — Ga: normal walking on level ground
  — Si: treadmill walking
  — Ju: walking with rhythmic auditory stimulation (RAS)

• Cohort condition may explain more PCA variance than diagnosis
• → PCA/t-SNE panels B always show cohort colouring to detect this

• Imbalanced severity: H&Y 2=19, H&Y 2.5=14, H&Y 3.0=7 subjects
• → SMOTE applied on training folds only to address imbalance
